a.xlink:title: Expands convex cost arcs ``arc(From, To, Lower, Segments)`` where each segment is ``segment(Width, MarginalCost)``. Widths are positive integers and marginal costs are nondecreasing integers; the original cost at flow amount ``X`` is the sum of the marginal costs of its first ``X`` units, with cost zero at amount zero. Each expanded arc receives the lower-bound portion of the original flow in segment order. The opaque mapping records a ground public network snapshot (vertices and arcs), and preserves original arc and segment order.

Projects a capacity-valid flow on the expanded network to original ``flow(ArcId, From, To, Amount)`` entries, omitting zero flows. Rejects a noncanonical segment allocation when a more expensive segment carries optional flow while a cheaper segment has unused capacity. Arbitrary distribution across equal-cost segments is accepted. The original convex arcs are not themselves a core flow network.
